reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, is it really tested. I already lift three times a week and sleep badly, and $24.99 for a first box with a money-back guarantee is low risk for an impulse buy.
objection: A lab report on a page is only worth something if the lab is real and the batch number actually matches. I will check that before I trust it. Also, 200 mg is a decent dose but I do not know if it will do anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab name looked made up or I could not find the report for my batch when I scanned the code, I would not buy.
